title: Cell Offset Bound
statement: Let a segment be a Boolean word together with a flag, and let a finite list of such segments be given. For indices $s,c\in\mathbb{N}$ and a Boolean $p$, if $c$ is less than the word length of the defaulted $s$th segment, then the cell offset for that segment and position is strictly less than its rendered length.
hypotheses_covered: c is less than the word length of the defaulted s-th segment
